newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine mortgage bank to issue $106 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentine mortgage bank to issue $106 mln bond.

text.p: Argentina's state-owned mortgage bank, Banco Hipotecario Nacional, is going to issue a $106 million five-year bond, a banker said Monday.
The bond will be launched on Tuesday and will yield around 7.60 percent, a banker close to the deal told Reuters.
The bond is a mortgage-backed security and is aimed at U.S. investment funds and institutional investors, the banker said. The price of the bond will be closed Wednesday.
It is rated BBB- by Standard & Poor's, said the source.
The lower house of Argentina's Congress is due to debate the privatization of Hipotecario Tuesday.
Hipotecario has the largest assets of any Argentine bank at $4.31 billion and its privatization has been valued at up to $3.0 billion.
